title: SWF: FrameLabel tag (tag 43) encoding in exported SWF
description: Test that keyframes with non-empty .label fields produce FrameLabel (tag 43) records in the SWF byte stream. Verify: (1) tag type 43, (2) label string stored as null-terminated ASCII, (3) correct placement order relative to PlaceObject2 tags. Also test that label with labelType='anchor' emits FrameLabel2 (tag 43 with extra byte 0x01) per SWF spec.
